first_look.what: each round as it came out, on repositories the rules had not been run on, with the rules as they stood before that round's fixes

before_the_review.what: every repository with the check as it was before the independent review: arguments and uses read from text

before_receiver_types.what: every repository with the check as it was merged first: a member call counted only on self/this or its type's name

shipped_rules.what: every repository again with the check as shipped, which reads the syntax tree; not a held-out measurement, since the rules were changed after looking at these
